The '''Aztubek system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Javin sector/Legends|Javin sector]] in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] region of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], which contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Aztubek/Legends|Aztubek]].
